name: Somchai Ratanakosin
bio:
Somchai Ratanakosin's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly during his university days, when he volunteered to help a local racing team manage their data infrastructure. His keen eye for detail and problem-solving skills quickly made him an indispensable part of the team. After graduating with a degree in Computer Engineering, he dedicated himself to merging his passion for technology with the exhilarating world of racing.

As the IT Systems Manager for Kosmic Kart, Somchai is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems, from data acquisition on the track to the team's communication network. He is a firm believer in leveraging technology to gain a competitive edge, and he is constantly exploring new and innovative ways to improve the team's performance. Somchai’s ability to see the big picture, combined with his technical expertise, makes him a vital asset to Kosmic Kart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Somchai is of average height, with a thoughtful expression and a wiry build.

quirks: Always carries a small Rubik's Cube and solves it during stressful situations.
Insists on using exclusively open-source software.
Has an encyclopedic knowledge of obscure computer programming languages.
